items.summary: It was discovered that the GNU binutils gold linker incorrectly handled certain ELF files. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to cause GNU binutils to crash, resulting in a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. items.summary: Adam Bedard discovered that libXi did not properly validate DEVICE_RESOLUTION replies from the X server, which could result in a heap buffer overflow. items.title: USN-9212-1: PyJWT vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that PyJWT incorrectly handled errors when parsing deeply nested token headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using PyJWT to fail unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service. items.title: USN-9211-1: Plexus Utils vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Plexus Utils did not properly sanitize file paths when extracting archives. If a user or automated system were tricked into extracting a specially crafted archive, an attacker could possibly use this issue to write arbitrary files and execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9190-2: Linux kernel (HWE) vulnerabilities
items.summary: Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems: - S390 architecture; - x86 architecture; - Block layer subsystem; - Cryptographic API; - Compute Acceleration Framework;

items.title: USN-9208-1: alsa-lib vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that the ALSA library incorrectly handled certain crafted topology files and control element identifiers. An attacker could possibly use these issues to cause a denial of service or expose sensitive information. These issues were only addressed in Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS

items.title: USN-9209-1: Simple DirectMedia Layer vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Simple DirectMedia Layer incorrectly handled memory when encountering errors during OpenGL ES streaming texture creation. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using Simple DirectMedia Layer to consume resources, resulting in a denial of service.

items.title: USN-9207-1: Apache Commons BCEL vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Apache Commons BCEL incorrectly cached classes under their self-declared names without validating them against the requested name. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause BCEL to return or verify a different class than the one requested.

items.title: USN-9204-1: dav1d vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that dav1d incorrectly handled certain AV1 video streams with extremely large frame sizes. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause dav1d to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

items.summary: Jin Wei, Kunwei Qian, and Ping Chen discovered that libpcap did not properly validate the format of MAC addresses passed to the pcap_ether_aton() function, leading to an out-of-bounds read and write.
